graphs.domain: all labeled simple graphs on six vertices
graphs.representation: sorted degree sequence and triangle count

set_cover.domain: five-set covering subfamilies of the 31 nonempty subsets of a five-element labeled universe

two_cnf.domain: five-clause subsets of the 24 non-tautological binary clauses on four labeled variables
two_cnf.representation: signed variable occurrence counts and labeled unsigned variable-pair co-occurrence counts

endpoint_selection.fibre: maximum target diameter, then maximum multiplicity, then canonical representation bytes
endpoint_selection.witness: minimum canonical instance bytes at each target endpoint
endpoint_selection.third_checker: recompute the selected representation and both endpoint targets with a small direct checker

target_solver_rule: two structurally different exact solvers must agree instance by instance or execution aborts
